full_prompt_en: A quiet black-and-white photograph shows a solitary walker on a narrow waterside path in heavy morning mist. The image is composed with a broad, nearly empty expanse of pale fog occupying the left half, while a dark bank enters from the right and tapers toward the vanishing distance. Two leafless trees rise from the bank, one slender and sharply branching in the foreground and a softer, denser one partly hidden behind it. Their crowns dissolve gradually into the haze instead of forming hard silhouettes. Near the far end of the visible shore, a few tiny figures stand apart, giving a human scale to the open space without dominating it. Below the bank, very still dark water holds a soft inverted reflection of the trees, with the shoreline making a long diagonal division between the airy upper field and the deeper lower field. The photograph has a restrained mid-century documentary character: fine film grain, muted silver grays, deep but not crushed blacks, and delicate tonal transitions through the fog. Diffuse overcast light removes strong shadows and lets the bare branches, dark trunks, and reflected shapes carry the visual structure. The frame feels patient and spacious, with no theatrical gesture; distance and silence emerge from the simple balance of mist, land, water, and small human forms.
full_prompt_zh: 一张安静的黑白照片，表现浓雾清晨里沿窄窄水岸小径独行的人。画面左半部是大面积几乎空白的浅色雾气，右侧伸入一条深色河岸，并向远处逐渐收窄。岸上立着两棵落叶树，前方一棵树干细长、枝杈清晰，后方较密的一棵部分隐入雾中。树冠随着距离慢慢消散在灰白空气里，而不是形成坚硬的剪影。可见岸线的远端还有几个相隔而立的微小人影，为开阔空间提供尺度，却不喧宾夺主。河岸下方的深色静水映出树木柔和的倒影，岸线形成一条长长的斜线，把轻盈的上半部与更深沉的下半部分开。照片带有克制的世纪中叶纪实气质：细密胶片颗粒、低饱和度的银灰色阶、深而不死黑的暗部，以及雾中细腻的明暗过渡。阴天漫射光消除了强烈投影，让光秃树枝、深色树干和倒影承担画面的视觉结构。整个画面从容而疏朗，没有戏剧化姿态；雾、陆地、水和细小人形之间的简单平衡带出距离感与寂静感。
style_prompt_en: A restrained monochrome film photograph with fine, even grain and a broad range of muted silver grays. Large open areas of pale atmospheric tone balance a few dark, slender vertical forms and their softened echoes. Edges fade gradually with distance, while near details remain clear enough to anchor the image. Diffuse light produces gentle transitions instead of sharp cast shadows; dark values stay rich without closing completely. A long diagonal division and generous negative space create a patient, spacious rhythm. The overall mood is quiet and observational, with understated documentary realism and no polished digital crispness.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的黑白胶片摄影风格，颗粒细而均匀，银灰色阶柔和且层次宽广。大片浅色空气感区域与少数深色细长竖向形体及其柔化的呼应相平衡。边缘随距离逐渐消隐，近处细节则保持足够清晰以稳定画面。漫射光带来平缓过渡而非锐利投影；深色浓郁却不完全堵死。长斜线的分割与充裕留白形成从容开阔的节奏。整体气质安静、观察式，具有不张扬的纪实真实感，没有数字图像过度锐利的质感。
theme_en: A solitary walk beside still water in heavy morning mist
theme_zh: 浓雾清晨里沿静水独行
name: Kees Scherer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
